status: exact public Lean endpoint complete; cross-assistant bridge and M4.2-M4.6 incomplete
scope: Exact live public parser acceptance in both directions, every field and width, generic little-endian byte windows, independent complete public-frame encoding round trip, and six accepted/four rejected ordinary-kernel witnesses.
parser_connection: The proof alias directly references _private.LeanCageM3.Results.0.LeanCageM3.parseResult. A small elaborator constructs that constant reference, and the ordinary Lean kernel checks live_decode_view and every downstream proof. There is no copied-parser equality assumption, additional axiom or trusted native computation.
acceptance: For every byte array and Result, public decode success iff the actual header is valid, the entry word is the selected Entry code, cleanup is at most one, all returned fields are exactly the actual byte projections, and live resultValid is true.
encoding: The independent proof-side encoder has exact fields and digest. For every Result satisfying its actual field-width bounds and digest size 32, decodeResult(encodeResult r) = validateResult r. Semantic validity is not assumed by this round-trip theorem.
nonvacuity: Ordinary-kernel accepted witnesses: EXIT detail 42, SETUP stage 8/error 13, SIGNAL 9, CANCELLED with trigger 1, UNKNOWN stage 9/error 71, and PREFLIGHT. Rejected witnesses: private ADMITTED/ENTERED, public two-byte kind 256, and signal detail 65.
private_public_boundary: Public kind 256 is encoded in two bytes and rejected. It is not the same encoding as the private sender narrowing original kind 256 into a one-byte zero. Public endpoint proofs do not establish equivalence with the private decoder or transport authenticity.
observation_boundary: Only the actual Lean public endpoint and its independent proof-side encoding are connected. No translation of Rocq terms, Linux byte delivery, observation authenticity, controller ordering or executable correspondence is inferred.
printing_context: All five Rocq query groups and their 48-, 91-, 154-, 197- and 212-module contexts remain unchanged. Twelve preceding Lean full types/foundations remain exact; all new authored and generated Lean theorem records are included.
tool_profile: Unchanged pinned CompCert commit 14d616046360a0b2611ebdfc2f98368af402e1f7 (VERSION 3.17), Coq 8.18.0 and OCaml 4.14.1. Source/frontend/extraction correctness remains trusted; no compiler preservation theorem applied to the extended machine.
lean_replay: The maintained Endpoints.lean and Public.lean source list is checked exhaustively through the existing ordinary Lean declaration/type/transitive-axiom audit. Unlisted or missing maintained Lean sources fail closed.
audit_allowance: Connection wrapper remains 900 seconds; M4.1 remains 300 seconds and individual prover/coqchk bounds remain 180 seconds. Full compilation/type/foundation/artifact/tamper checks remain enabled.
deployment: Original native helper, M3 runtime source, extraction, maintained dependency pins and VM profiles are unchanged. The encoder is proof-side only. Any separate ignored bridge-tool experiment is outside this assurance record.
